# Import clean OTU tables

```{r readin-clean-rds, echo=F, eval=F}
Bac<-readRDS(file = "../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Bac_wholecommunity.rds")
#old
  # otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 23156 taxa and 533 samples ]
  # sample_data() Sample Data:       [ 533 samples by 39 sample variables ]
#new
  # otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 22661 taxa and 484 samples ]
  # sample_data() Sample Data:       [ 484 samples by 64 sample variables ]
  # tax_table()   Taxonomy Table:    [ 22661 taxa by 6 taxonomic ranks ]
Fun<-readRDS(file = "../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Fun_wholecommunity.rds")
#old
  # otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 6749 taxa and 509 samples ]
  # sample_data() Sample Data:       [ 509 samples by 39 sample variables ]
#new
  # otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 6626 taxa and 484 samples ]
  # sample_data() Sample Data:       [ 484 samples by 66 sample variables ]
  # tax_table()   Taxonomy Table:    [ 6626 taxa by 7 taxonomic ranks ]


#to view
as.data.frame.matrix(tax_table(Fun_wholecommunity))$Sign

#fun
Fun_wholecommunity_wGvS <- Fun_wholecommunity
cft<-as.data.frame.matrix(tax_table(Fun_wholecommunity))
cft$OTU_Sign <- cft$Sign
cft$OTU_Sign <- as.factor(cft$OTU_Sign)
cft$OTU_Sign <- revalue(cft$OTU_Sign, c("Singleton" = "Singletons"))
cft$OTU_Sign <- factor(cft$OTU_Sign, levels = c("Generalists","Specialists","NS","Singletons"))
cft$Sign <- NULL
tax_table(Fun_wholecommunity_wGvS) <- tax_table(as.matrix(cft))
head(tax_table(Fun_wholecommunity_wGvS))

cft2<-subset(cft, select = -OTU_Sign)
tax_table(Fun_wholecommunity) <- tax_table(as.matrix(cft2))
head(tax_table(Fun_wholecommunity))

#bac
Bac_wholecommunity_wGvS <- Bac_wholecommunity

cbt<-as.data.frame.matrix(tax_table(Bac_wholecommunity))
cbt$OTU_Sign <- cbt$Sign
cbt$Sign <- NULL
cbt<-cbt %>% dplyr::mutate(OTU_Sign = replace_na(OTU_Sign, "Singletons"))
cbt$OTU_Sign <- factor(cbt$OTU_Sign, levels = c("Generalists","Specialists","NS","Singletons"))

tax_table(Bac_wholecommunity_wGvS) <- tax_table(as.matrix(cbt))
head(tax_table(Bac_wholecommunity_wGvS))

cbt2<-subset(cbt, select = -OTU_Sign)
tax_table(Bac_wholecommunity) <- tax_table(as.matrix(cbt2))
head(tax_table(Bac_wholecommunity))


# removing GvS taxonomy col (and saving for export)
Fun_wholecommunity.r  = transform_sample_counts(Fun_wholecommunity, function(x) x / sum(x) )
saveRDS(Fun_wholecommunity.r, file = "../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Fun_wholecommunity.r.rds") 
saveRDS(Fun_wholecommunity, file = "../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Fun_wholecommunity.rds") 
saveRDS(Fun_wholecommunity_wGvS, file = "../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Fun_wholecommunity_wGvS.rds") 

Bac_wholecommunity.r  = transform_sample_counts(Bac_wholecommunity, function(x) x / sum(x) )
saveRDS(Bac_wholecommunity.r, file = "../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Bac_wholecommunity.r.rds") 
saveRDS(Bac_wholecommunity, file = "../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Bac_wholecommunity.rds") 
saveRDS(Bac_wholecommunity_wGvS, file = "../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Bac_wholecommunity_wGvS.rds") 

Bac<-Bac_wholecommunity
Fun<-Fun_wholecommunity
```

```{r fix-cyano-naming-phylo-object, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}

tax_table(DATASET1)[,colnames(tax_table(DATASET1))] <- gsub(tax_table(DATASET1)[,colnames(tax_table(DATASET1))],pattern="Cyanobacteria/Chloroplast",replacement="Cyanobacteria")

    # get_taxa_unique(DATASET1, taxonomic.rank = "Phylum")

tax_table(DATASET2)[,colnames(tax_table(DATASET2))] <- gsub(tax_table(DATASET2)[,colnames(tax_table(DATASET2))],pattern="Cyanobacteria/Chloroplast",replacement="Cyanobacteria")

    # get_taxa_unique(DATASET2, taxonomic.rank = "Phylum")

# save

saveRDS(DATASET2, file = "../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/RDS2.rds")
```

- `r prettyNum(nsamples(Bac),big.mark = ",")` samples

**Fungal Dataset:**

- `r prettyNum(ntaxa(Fun),big.mark = ",")` OTUs
- `r prettyNum(nsamples(Fun),big.mark = ",")` samples

## Global: Calculate  mean relative abundance by tax rank and export csv of relative abundance 

### merge samples within dataset 

```{r merge-all-samples-by-dataset, include=F, eval=F, cache=TRUE}
# merge all samples to calculate mean relative abundance by tax rank
Bac_merged <- merge_samples(Bac, "Edge",fun=mean)
Fun_merged <- merge_samples(Fun, "Edge",fun=mean)
```

### tax glom and export 
(no generating code just copy and replace)

```{r glom-merged-obs-by-rank-and-export-relabund-csv, include=F, eval=F, cache=TRUE}
Bac_merged.Phylum <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(Bac_merged.Phylum.A) > 0, Bac_merged.Phylum.A)
Bac_merged.Phylum.r  = transform_sample_counts(Bac_merged.Phylum, function(x) x / sum(x) )
length(get_taxa_unique(Bac_merged.Phylum.r, taxonomic.rank = "Phylum"))
  #35

sample_names(Bac_merged.Phylum.r)<-"Bac_Phylum_Mean"

colnames(Bac_Phylum_Mean_Abund)[1]<-"Bac_OTU"
```

## Samples: Calculate relative abundance by tax rank and export csv of relative abundance {.unlisted .unnumbered .hidden} 


1. create vectors of top 10 taxa names to plot for all ranks
  - auto-generated code found: 
  a. set minimum threshold of 0.5% all-sample (a.k.a global) mean relative abundance
    - (so that taxa below this threshold won't get plotted)
2. tax glom by each rank
3. transform to relative abundance
3. psmelt
4. add column "[rank]_all" to preserve names not in top 10 
5. recode all taxa not in top 10 to by "LowAbundance" & revalue with specifics later (in dat_Bac.[rank].r and in dat_Fun.[rank].r)


### generating code: 

```{r auto-populate-rank-names-to-plot-Bac, results='asis', eval=F}
Bac.rank.names<-rank_names(Bac)[2:6]
# add this line to beginning
  #  cat('\n # Set min plotting threshold to 0.5% relative abundance (all-sample a.k.a global mean) \n')

#also adding psmelt step

for(rank in Bac.rank.names) {

  cat('\n## \n')

  cat('################## \n')

  cat('# Bac:', rank, '# \n')

  cat('################## \n')

  cat('\n')
  
   cat('min_nname_Bac_', rank, '<-length(unique(Bac_', rank, '_Mean_Abund$', 
       rank, '[Bac_', rank, '_Mean_Abund$Bac_', rank, '_Mean > 0.5]))',
       sep = '')
  
  cat('\n \n ')

    cat('if (min_nname_Bac_', rank, ' < 10){
  Bac.', rank, '.names.to.plot<-top_n(Bac_', rank, '_Mean_Abund, min_nname_Bac_', rank, ', Bac_', rank, '_Mean)$',rank, ' 
} else {
  Bac.', rank, '.names.to.plot<-top_n(Bac_', rank, '_Mean_Abund, 10, Bac_', rank, '_Mean)$', rank, '
}', sep = '')

  cat('\n# \n')
  
  cat('\nBac.',rank,'.A <- tax_glom(Bac, taxrank="',rank,'")\n',sep = '')
  
  cat('Bac.',rank,' <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(Bac.',rank,'.A) > 0, Bac.',rank,'.A)\n',sep = '')

  cat('Bac.',rank,'.r  = transform_sample_counts(Bac.',rank,', function(x) x / sum(x) )\n',sep = '')

  cat('dat_Bac.',rank,'.r <- psmelt(Bac.',rank,'.r)\n',sep = '')

  cat('dat_Bac.',rank,'.r$',rank,' <- as.character(dat_Bac.',rank,'.r$',rank,') \n',sep = '')

  cat('dat_Bac.',rank,'.r$',rank,'_all <- dat_Bac.',rank,'.r$',rank,' \n',sep = '')
  
  cat('dat_Bac.',rank,'.r$',rank,' <- if_else(dat_Bac.',rank,'.r$',rank,' %in% Bac.',rank,'.names.to.plot, dat_Bac.',rank,'.r$',rank,', "LowAbundance") \n',sep = '')

  cat('\n## \n')

  cat('\n \n')

}
```

```{r auto-populate-rank-names-to-plot-Fun, results='asis', eval=F}
Fun.rank.names<-rank_names(Fun)[2:7] #change 6 to 7 if fungal

# add this line to beginning
  #  cat('\n # Set min plotting threshold to 0.5% relative abundance (all-sample a.k.a global mean) \n')

#also adding psmelt step

for(rank in Fun.rank.names) {

  cat('\n## \n')

  cat('################## \n')

  cat('# Fun:', rank, '# \n')

  cat('################## \n')

  cat('\n')
  
   cat('min_nname_Fun_', rank, '<-length(unique(Fun_', rank, '_Mean_Abund$', 
       rank, '[Fun_', rank, '_Mean_Abund$Fun_', rank, '_Mean > 0.5]))',
       sep = '')
  
  cat('\n \n ')

    cat('if (min_nname_Fun_', rank, ' < 10){
  Fun.', rank, '.names.to.plot<-top_n(Fun_', rank, '_Mean_Abund, min_nname_Fun_', rank, ', Fun_', rank, '_Mean)$',rank, ' 
} else {
  Fun.', rank, '.names.to.plot<-top_n(Fun_', rank, '_Mean_Abund, 10, Fun_', rank, '_Mean)$', rank, '
}', sep = '')

  cat('\n# \n')
  
  cat('\nFun.',rank,'.A <- tax_glom(Fun, taxrank="',rank,'")\n',sep = '')
  
  cat('Fun.',rank,' <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(Fun.',rank,'.A) > 0, Fun.',rank,'.A)\n',sep = '')

  cat('Fun.',rank,'.r  = transform_sample_counts(Fun.',rank,', function(x) x / sum(x) )\n',sep = '')

  cat('dat_Fun.',rank,'.r <- psmelt(Fun.',rank,'.r)\n',sep = '')

  cat('dat_Fun.',rank,'.r$',rank,' <- as.character(dat_Fun.',rank,'.r$',rank,') \n',sep = '')

  cat('dat_Fun.',rank,'.r$',rank,'_all <- dat_Fun.',rank,'.r$',rank,' \n',sep = '')
  
  cat('dat_Fun.',rank,'.r$',rank,' <- if_else(dat_Fun.',rank,'.r$',rank,' %in% Fun.',rank,'.names.to.plot, dat_Fun.',rank,'.r$',rank,', "LowAbundance") \n',sep = '')

  cat('\n## \n')

  cat('\n \n')

}
```

```{r Fun group low abundance, include=F, eval=F}
# dat_Fun.Sign.r$Sign[dat_Fun.Sign.r$Sign == "LowAbundance"] <- paste("\u2264 ",round(Fun_Sign_Mean_Abund[10,9],1),"% relative abundance", sep = "") 
dat_Fun.Sign.r$Sign<-factor(dat_Fun.Sign.r$Sign)
levels(dat_Fun.Sign.r$Sign)
# dat_Fun.Sign.r$Sign[dat_Fun.Sign.r$Sign == "Singleton"] <- "Singletons"
dat_Fun.Sign.r$Sign<-factor(dat_Fun.Sign.r$Sign, levels = c("Generalists","Specialists","Singleton","NS"))

# save dat files
saveRDS(dat_Fun.Sign.r, file = "../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/tax_dat/dat_Fun.Sign.r.rds")
```

# **Across Different Sites by Grass Hosts** {.unnumbered .tabset}

## Phylum {.unnumbered .tabset .tabset-pills}

### Bacteria-Archaea {.unnumbered .tabset}

```{r autogen-SitebyGrass-Bac-Phylum, echo=F, results='asis', cache=TRUE}
#cut=Site
#color=Grass
#carat=sample_name
#clarity=Phylum
#price=Abundance
#col=fill

BA_tabs <- sort(unique(dat_Bac.Phylum.r$Site))



for(tab in BA_tabs) {

  cat('\n')

  cat('#### ', tab, '{.unnumbered .tabset .tabset-pills}   \n')

  cat('\n')


  sub_values <- dat_Bac.Phylum.r %>% filter(Site == tab)

  subtabs <- sort(unique(sub_values$Grass))


  for(subtab in subtabs) {

    cat('\n')

    cat('##### ', subtab, '{.unnumbered}   \n')

    cat('\n')

    plot_values <- sub_values %>% filter(Grass == subtab)


    print(ggplot(plot_values, aes(x = sample_name,y = as.numeric(Abundance*100), fill = Phylum)) +
          geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
          scale_fill_manual(values = Bac_Phylum_cols) +
          labs(x = '\n Site x Grass x Replicate',
               y = 'Relative Abundance \n',
               fill = 'Phylum') +
          theme_bw()+
          theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", size=9, angle = 90, hjust=1,vjust=.5),
            axis.text.y = element_text(color="black", size=12),
            strip.text = element_text(color="black", size=12),
            strip.background = element_blank(),
            legend.title = element_text(color="black", size=12),
            legend.text = element_text(color="black", size=10),
            legend.key.height = unit(0.5, 'cm'),
            axis.title.x = element_text(color="black", size=14),
            axis.title.y = element_text(color="black", size=14, angle=90),
            plot.title = element_text(size=14),
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # switch off major gridlines
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # switch off minor gridlines
            panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=.75)
            )
          )


    cat('\n')

  }

}
```
